QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: toolbarHeightPercent
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Toolbar height as a percentage of the window height.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The toolbar height is calculated from the main window content height, this percentage and the layout scale factor, then clamped to the font-derived minimum (at most 20% of the window height).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Toolbar height

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: statusBarHeightPercent
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Status bar height as a percentage of the window height.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The status bar height is calculated from the window height, this percentage and the layout scale factor, then clamped between a content-derived minimum and 15% of the window height.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Status bar height

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rightPanelMinPercent
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Minimum right panel width as a percentage of the window width.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The right panel width is calculated from the window width, this percentage and the layout scale factor, then capped at 45% of the window. There is no content-derived minimum: the panel content (instruments, task card buttons) adapts to the panel width instead.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Right panel minimum width

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rightPanelMaxPercent
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum right panel width as a percentage of the window width.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Upper bound for the right panel width. Content-driven widening is clamped to this value, and never above 55% of the window width.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Right panel maximum width

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fontScalePercent
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Font scale applied on top of the UI Scaling setting.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Multiplies the platform font size (together with the existing UI Scaling setting). Lower it on small screens so that the font-derived minimum heights of the toolbar and status bar shrink and the percentage-based sizes can take effect. This value is set per device; it is never derived from the screen resolution automatically.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Font scale

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: scaleFactor
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Manual scale factor applied to the layout percentages.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Multiplies the calculated toolbar height, status bar height and right panel width. Each result is still clamped to its hard bound (toolbar 20%, status bar 15%, right panel 45%/55% of the window), so a factor beyond that stops growing the element. This value is set per device; it is never derived from the screen resolution automatically.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Layout scale factor
